description: Code-agnostic interface for ASH-derived character creation and progression within the Narrative Engine.

methods.name: create_character_seed
methods.description: Create a CharacterSeedManifest from ASH-derived pressure without locking destiny at creation.

methods.name: derive_identity_pressure
methods.description: Derive identity pressure for progressive revelation through play.

methods.name: record_progression_delta
methods.description: Persist progression as a traced delta instead of untracked character mutation.

methods.name: apply_player_state_delta
methods.description: Apply a PlayerStateDelta that cites the progression delta and ASH provenance.

invariants: Character creation requires CosmicPatternSnapshot, DiagnosticEnvelope, and GenerationPlan.
Every CharacterSeedManifest carries source_ash_refs with normalized_state, source_orbit_id, active_codeword_sequence, diagnostic_ref, and generation_plan_ref.
Identity is revealed through play and must not lock destiny at creation.
Wolf balance fields are not a good/evil or zero-sum morality axis.

ash_alignment_contract.math_basis: F2^9 full-state ASH vector with exactly 16 canonical codewords and x' = x XOR c transitions
ash_alignment_contract.truth_boundary: GenerationPlan may guide character seed and progression materialization; character systems must not author ASH truth or YWE domain truth.
ash_alignment_contract.engine_contract_rule: Character creation and progression requests must reject meaningful generation when CosmicPatternSnapshot, DiagnosticEnvelope, or GenerationPlan provenance is missing.

purpose: Defines the character creation and progression interface for ASH-derived CharacterSeedManifest, IdentityPressureVector, ProgressionDelta, and PlayerStateDelta records.
